old: How to Use This Application Hub
new: How Application Requirements Shape TiO₂ Selection

old: Start with the category that matches what you make. Review more than one path if your work spans several applications.
new: Identify the formulation, resin, binder, furnish, ink vehicle, processing route or other system context relevant to the application.

old: Use current technical data to compare the grades under review against your requirements.
new: Review grade-specific technical information against the properties and methods that matter for the intended application.

old: Check the grade in your formulation and process before making a specification decision.
new: Confirm suitability through formulation, processing and performance testing under your own conditions.

old: If you have not selected a grade, choose “Not sure / Need help” on the quotation form. For an application that is still undecided, choose “Other / Not sure”.
new: If you have not selected a grade, share your application, formulation or processing requirements and request grade-selection support.
